title: Fluidized Bed Dryer
model_title: Continuous Fluidised Bed Dryer (Plenum, Distributor, Bed, Freeboard)

introduction.definition: A fluidised bed dryer blows hot air up through a perforated distributor plate at a velocity just high enough to lift the particles, so the bed behaves like a boiling liquid. Every particle is surrounded by hot air, giving fast and even drying. In continuous units the bed flows from the feed point over a weir to the outlet.
applications: Granules, crystals and pellets (salt, sugar, fertiliser, plastics)
key_points: Air velocity above minimum fluidisation velocity
Particles must be fluidisable (not too fine/sticky)
introduction.summary: A fluidised bed dryer blows hot air up through a perforated plate so a bed of particles lifts and behaves like a boiling liquid. Intense contact between air and every particle gives fast, uniform drying; in continuous units the bed flows from the feed point over a weir to the outlet.

temperature.description: Air blown up through the distributor at just above the minimum fluidisation velocity makes the particles behave like a boiling liquid. Every particle is surrounded by hot air, so drying is fast and the bed temperature is uniform. Bed depth (weir height) and air temperature set residence time and final moisture.

video_tutorials.title: Fluidized Bed Dryer — Introduction

script.narration: This module introduces the Fluidized Bed Dryer.
A fluidised bed dryer blows hot air up through a perforated distributor plate at a velocity just high enough to lift the particles, so the bed behaves like a boiling liquid.
Every particle is surrounded by hot air, giving fast and even drying.
In continuous units the bed flows from the feed point over a weir to the outlet.
Typical applications include granules, crystals and pellets (salt, sugar, fertiliser, plastics); pharmaceutical granules; food powders and agglomerates.
The cutaway reveals the internal construction: Dryer Body: Plenum (below) & Freeboard (above the bed), Supply Air Fan Impeller.
The exploded view separates every component so each one can be tapped for its function, material and failure modes.
Next, watch the operation tutorial to see how it works.

video_tutorials.title: Fluidized Bed Dryer — Operation

script.narration: How the Fluidized Bed Dryer works.
Hot air from the heater enters the plenum.
The distributor spreads the air evenly.
Particles fluidise and dry in the bed.
Dried product overflows the weir to the outlet.
The cyclone captures fines from exhaust air.
The flow overlay traces the liquid from suction to discharge.
Air blown up through the distributor at just above the minimum fluidisation velocity makes the particles behave like a boiling liquid.

video_tutorials.title: Fluidized Bed Dryer — Maintenance

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Fluidized Bed Dryer.
Check bed ΔP, temperatures and moisture.
Clean distributor holes; check cyclone.
Inspect fan and heater.
Watch for defluidisation/channelling: wet lumps, hot spots. Common cause: sticky feed, blocked distributor.
Watch for excess fines carry-over: cyclone overload. Common cause: too high air velocity.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.
